description.value: The Loaf is a small Italian restaurant that opened in 2024 in the heart of downtown Fernie, serving brunch plates, fresh pasta, and a Neapolitan pizza fermented for seventy-two hours. The kitchen shapes focaccia each morning from the same slow-fermented dough used for their pizza crust. The menu rotates regularly and leans on quality ingredients in a quiet, high-ceilinged room on 2nd Avenue.
